workLog.step: Measured current main: 29 shared agent templates, 18 orchestrator rows, 13 template agents absent from the matrix. Excluding orchestrator itself leaves 12 candidates.
No live model proof was available because ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was unset. Static evidence uses realistic request phrases against the committed routing matrix and installed prompt files.

Selected 5 agents for rows: backlog-generator, debug, dependency-auditor, pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter. Excluded 7 candidate agents because they are skill-first routes, subsets of existing routed agents, or outside engineering orchestration.
Added src/claude/backlog-generator.md because adding a row without the Claude source prompt made src/claude/orchestrator route to a missing agent.
Measured always-on orchestrator prompt growth: each orchestrator surface grew by 451 bytes, for 2706 bytes across six committed surfaces.
Revert check in sibling worktree ai-agents-3585-revert restored orchestrator surfaces to origin/main while keeping tests. Result: all 30 tests failed.
Learnings captured: routing rows must be sparse and request-shaped. A row earns its bytes only when a realistic request maps to a distinct installed agent and no cheaper skill-first path owns it.
